blocks.text: 🪝 India's 1st Private Gold Mine Begins Commercial Operations at Jonnagiri (Kurnool, AP). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu inaugurates Geomysore Services primary gold mining project.
Private Gold Mine: India's 1st operational private primary gold mine launched at Swarnagiri (Jonnagiri), Kurnool district, AP.
Operator: Developed and operated by Geomysore Services India Pvt Ltd (GMSI).
